name: DocILE: Document Information Localization and Extraction Benchmark
description: DocILE is an extensive benchmark and dataset for document information localization and extraction, focusing on key information extraction (KIE) and line item recognition (LIR) from business documents (including invoices, orders, and receipts). Developed by Rossum in collaboration with University of La Rochelle and Computer Vision Center (CVC) UAB for the CLEF 2023 Lab and ICDAR 2023 Competition, DocILE features 106,680 annotated and synthetic documents. This comprises 6,680 human-annotated real business documents (train/val/test splits) with 55 distinct field types and 100,000 synthetic documents with full ground truth. The benchmark is paired with an open Python library (docile-benchmark) and pre-computed OCR.
